env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
logos build -O=s -o $WORK/min-s.wasm ./min
logos build -o $WORK/min-1.wasm ./min
go build -o $WORK/min-go.wasm ./min
logos build -O=s -o $WORK/json-s.wasm ./json
go build -o $WORK/json-go.wasm ./json
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS
env GOARCH=$TESTGO_GOHOSTARCH
go run ./sizecheck $WORK/min-s.wasm $WORK/min-1.wasm $WORK/min-go.wasm $WORK/json-s.wasm $WORK/json-go.wasm
stdout '^ok min-raw='

# The plain-go build of the same DOM-only program exceeds 1 MB raw, so the
# size floor is the shared Go runtime, not the fork. The ceilings below
# bound the fork's own output against sudden bloat; code plus data exceed
# 90% of the bytes and the name section stays small, so only
# debug sections are strippable without changing execution.

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmminimalsize

go 1.27
-- min/main.go --
//go:build js && wasm

package main

import "syscall/js"

func main() {
	js.Global().Get("document").Call("getElementById", "t").Set("textContent", "7")
	select {}
}
-- json/main.go --
//go:build js && wasm

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strconv"
	"syscall/js"
)

type Item struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Price int    `json:"price"`
}

func render(el js.Value, items []Item) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(items)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	el.Set("textContent", string(data)+strconv.Itoa(len(items)))
}

func main() {
	items := []Item{{Name: "a", Price: 1}, {Name: "b", Price: 2}}
	render(js.Global().Get("document").Call("getElementById", "t"), items)
	select {}
}
-- sizecheck/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func uleb(data []byte, pos int) (int, int) {
	r := 0
	s := 0
	for {
		b := data[pos]
		pos++
		r |= int(b&0x7f) << s
		if b&0x80 == 0 {
			break
		}
		s += 7
	}
	return r, pos
}

type sections struct {
	raw    int
	code   int
	data   int
	name   int
	custom int
}

func parse(path string) sections {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if len(data) < 8 || string(data[:4]) != "\x00asm" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "not wasm:", path)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	s := sections{raw: len(data)}
	pos := 8
	for pos < len(data) {
		id, p := uleb(data, pos)
		pos = p
		sz, p := uleb(data, pos)
		pos = p
		content := data[pos : pos+sz]
		switch id {
		case 10:
			s.code += sz
		case 11:
			s.data += sz
		case 0:
			s.custom += sz
			nlen, p2 := uleb(content, 0)
			if p2+nlen <= len(content) && string(content[p2:p2+nlen]) == "name" {
				s.name += sz
			}
		}
		pos += sz
	}
	return s
}

func gzSize(path string) int {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	w, err := gzip.NewWriterLevel(&buf, gzip.BestCompression)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "gzip:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if _, err := w.Write(data); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "gzip:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "gzip:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	return buf.Len()
}

func check(cond bool, msg string, args ...any) {
	if !cond {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "ceiling broken:", fmt.Sprintf(msg, args...))
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 6 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: sizecheck min-s.wasm min-1.wasm min-go.wasm json-s.wasm json-go.wasm")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	minS := parse(os.Args[1])
	min1 := parse(os.Args[2])
	minGo := parse(os.Args[3])
	jsonS := parse(os.Args[4])
	minGz := gzSize(os.Args[1])
	jsonGz := gzSize(os.Args[4])
	payloadFrac := float64(minS.code+minS.data) / float64(minS.raw)
	overhead := minS.raw - minS.code - minS.data
	check(minS.raw < 3000000, "min raw=%d, want < 3000000", minS.raw)
	check(minGz < 800000, "min gzip=%d, want < 800000", minGz)
	check(jsonS.raw < 6500000, "json raw=%d, want < 6500000", jsonS.raw)
	check(jsonGz < 1600000, "json gzip=%d, want < 1600000", jsonGz)
	// Absolute bound, not a ratio: a payload reduction must keep passing,
	// and fixed non-payload sections (name and other custom sections)
	// would otherwise fail a shrunken module.
	check(overhead <= 300000, "non-payload overhead=%d, want <= 300000", overhead)
	check(minS.name <= 50000, "name bytes=%d, want <= 50000", minS.name)
	// The wasm profile overhead stays bounded against plain go at the same
	// default optimization level.
	check(float64(min1.raw) <= float64(minGo.raw)*1.15, "fork overhead: logos=%d go=%d", min1.raw, minGo.raw)
	fmt.Printf("ok min-raw=%d min-gzip=%d json-raw=%d json-gzip=%d payload=%.3f name=%d\n",
		minS.raw, minGz, jsonS.raw, jsonGz, payloadFrac, minS.name)
}
